items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public exposure, bounded beta, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish redistribution or commercial display rights; 0/4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement, security, and owner gates remain blocked; compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; revenue is one-day aggregate data with $4.92 commission not attributable to a site. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not expand alerts, monetize, deploy, alter configuration, or claim financial or causal lift.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress: official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts are identified. No task is closable because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, rollback evidence, and owner disposition remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not close tasks without direct evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. The source establishes access mechanics but not rights to fetch, store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize through affiliate or advertising use. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted uses, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate/advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Purpose and processing are understandable, but data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table including Slack delivery and access/session identifiers.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Measurement-only use after an explicit analytics choice is conditionally described, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking, remarketing, or customer matching.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Operational purpose is stated, but log fields, retention, access controls, deletion/request handling, vendor terms or DPA coverage, breach response, subpoena handling, and data-subject request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory, routing unresolved legal gaps to human counsel.

Retain containment-only execution. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots with 59 overflow items, 38 improvements awaiting measurement, and 17 failed implementations. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, legal/security evidence, and parked-site readiness work. Before new queue admission, record one verified completion or justified close with dated ownership, root cause or close rationale, isolated validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence.

Concrete launch decision for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net: remain parked, private, and preview-only. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker by 2026-09-30T17:00Z.

Revenue and attribution disposition: preserve Amazon's 2026-09-21 aggregate result of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; the aggregate tracking row cannot be assigned to a site. Require registered tracking IDs for new or repaired affiliate links. Do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal lift.
